Strict CDR3 sequence matching against a database

Source: R/tcr_db_matching.R
strict_single_chain_match_tcrs_to_db.Rd

Finds database entries where the CDR3alpha or CDR3beta amino acid sequence exactly matches a query TCR.

Usage

strict_single_chain_match_tcrs_to_db(tcr_df, organism, db_tcrs_tsvfile = NULL)

Arguments

tcr_df

A data.frame with columns cdr3a and cdr3b.

organism

Character string (e.g. "human", "mouse").

db_tcrs_tsvfile

Path to a TSV file. If NULL, uses the built-in organism-specific single-chain database.

Value

A list with elements alpha_matches and beta_matches, each a data.frame of matching database rows.

See also

match_tcrs_to_db, find_significant_tcrdist_matches

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
hits <- strict_single_chain_match_tcrs_to_db(tcr_df, "human")
hits$alpha_matches
hits$beta_matches
} # }
